Title: Lupine Observations
Description: Defeat Fangsnap in Fangsnap's Den for Survivalist Wilson in the Restless Shores Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Animals talking, walking on two legs, and at least one of them is even taking on human form.
InProgressResponse: If my suspicions are correct and animals really are taking on human form, things are gonna change.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You did it then? You hunted down the monstrous beast, Fangsnap?

Title: Pirates Will Pirate
Description: Defeat Neptunite Pirates and collect Pirate Booty from chests for Constable Muller in the Restless Shores Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Rilette Wilson's claiming there's a werewolf stalking the shore, and others say the Lost have gone to war.
InProgressResponse: I mean, how long have the Lost pirates of Aeternum been raiding the supplies of the living?It's normal Lost pirate behavior, nothing more.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Haha! You gave those damn buccaneers a little payback, didn't you? Let's see the spoils!

Title: War of the Lost
Description: Defeat Seele's Withered at the Decayed Campsite for Magistrate Gurkin in the Restless Shores Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Indeed. The Lost Buccaneers have been fighting the Withered and vice versa.
InProgressResponse: I tell you - I've fought them myself - I've seen the look in their eyes and the way it's changed.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You've seen for yourself now, haven't you? They fight with increased ferocity, with more precision, with purpose.

Title: The Greater Threat
Description: Kill Eastshore Forces at the Eastshore Pier and Gather Fishing Supplies for Magistrate Gurkin in the Restless Shores Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Yes! You get it, right? It sounds harmless in a way, but it's further evidence that they are more and more sentient.
InProgressResponse: There was a time I used to fish from the Eastshore Pier myself.That was back before it fell to the Lost in the first place.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Hah! No more fishing for the Lost! That should stop them from getting ideas.

Title: Disarmament
Description: Confiscate grenades from chests and destroy Ching Shih the Shark for Artificer Taethen in the Restless Shores Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Those blasted Lost Buccaneers are arming themselves, even developing new weapons.
InProgressResponse: Watch yourself out there. Rumor says the pirates' grenades are enhanced with Azoth. Never thought I'd see the day.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Took down Ching Shih the shark, did you? And you got the grenades? Well done, {playerName}.

Title: Slaying the Shadowslayer
Description: Kill Erika the Shadowslayer in Solitude Cemetery for Artificer Taethen in the Restless Shores Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Exactly. With the Pirates pushed back, the Withered are now on the offensive.
InProgressResponse: Destroy the Shadowslayer, {playerName}, whatever it takes.Then go and try to convince the Constable to finally acknowledge our plight.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: So you went out and dealt with the Shadowslayer? It's about time someone did that.

Title: Where The Boars Roam
Description: Defeat Boars and Tuskgore at Boarsholm for Survivalist Wilson in the Restless Shores Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I am quite certain that the boar in question is responsible for slaying a traveler to the north.
InProgressResponse: If we let this strange new mutation from the Angry Earth spread, our days our numbered.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: The deed's done then? Tuskgore is no more? That is a big relief.

Title: Scouting Report
Description: Destroy Channelview Pirates in Channelview Post and Oceanview Pirates in Oceanview Post and look for anything suspicious. Then report back to Constable Muller in the Restless Shores Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: That's the fort up on the hill. Once upon a time, that's where the region was governed from.
InProgressResponse: The more I think about this, the more I start to worry. Maybe I should've listened to Gurkin from the start.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Thank the stars you're back! What did you find? Runestones... what the heck?

Title: Damnation's Fall
Description: Defeat Admiral Reis in the center ship of Fort Damnation. Then report back to Constable Muller in the Restless Shores Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Launch a frontal attack on Fort Damnation? Are you out of your mind?
InProgressResponse: I'll give you this much - you've already proven to have the strength to back up your bravado - but if you're going to take on Admiral Reis, you'd best be prepared.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Well, I thought I'd see the sun rise in the west before I saw anyone take down Admiral Reis.

Title: Paying Respects
Description: Travel to Mourningdale and convey Barkeep Andris's respects to Barkeep Brewell.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: The Watcher there, Guerra - he fell to the Lost. Quite  a hero, I understand.
InProgressResponse: The news from Mourningdale is tragic, indeed.It almost make me feel guilty that things are going so well here.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Come and sit down and have a drink on the house, traveler.

Title: Archdeacon Azamela (Expedition)
Description: Collect the head of Archdeacon Azamela in The Depths for Magistrate Gurkin.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: You’re damn right, there is! The Corrupted! The Shattered Mountain?
InProgressResponse: Who knows what darkness this Archdeacon Azamela is cooking up in the Depths.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Is that it? You destroyed the Archdeacon, didn't you? There's another blow for righteousness and the good of humanity!

Title: Hoppy Trails
Description: Visit Rabbit Island and if you can find any signs of a curse then deal with them and then return to Survivalist Wilson in the Restless Shores Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: This request is a bit more... unconventional. There is a small island nearby I would like you to investigate.
InProgressResponse: A man used to live on that island all by his lonesome, kept to himself and his rabbits well enough.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: So the Harekeeper passed on? I'm glad you put him to rest. His furry friends will flourish with or without him, I suspect.

Title: The First Thing I Remember
Description: Discover Santiago Salazar's past by confronting members of his former crew and tracking down a ship manifest and their journal entries.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I have flashes of a ship voyage, but that doesn’t say much. Who here hasn't arrived by boat? But there's more...
InProgressResponse: I appreciate your help. I'd forget my own head if it wasn’t attached. What was I was looking for? My name on a manifest, right?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You're back! I feared you’d end up a soulless Withered, wandering the beaches like old Captain Cross.

Title: Footsteps on the Beach
Description: Retrace Santiago Salazars steps to find what he placed in a chest and recover Rosario's Manifest from one of his previous crewmembers.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: You’re too kind. But I’m certain the answer lies on these shores. At the bar in the settlement, I heard from Niki Andris that I sailed on the Rosario.
InProgressResponse: When I think of all my precious keepsakes scattered on these shores, I wonder what more I’m missing?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You’ve returned! And look at that! You found my missing jewelry! That ring! That brooch! And how could I forget that solid gold locket!

Title: The True Terror of the Seas
Description: Confront Santiago Salazar's previous captain Scurvyhook, and extract revenge to put Santiago's mind at ease.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: He now goes by Scurvyhook. Never was there a captain more cruel!
InProgressResponse: I finally understand why I tried so hard to forget my past.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Is the deed done? Have you destroyed those bilge rats and their vile captain? Has Scurvyhook been sent to the abyss?

Title: A Pirate's Life
Description: Follow a trail of Doubloons to reclaim the treasure Santiago's old crew had stashed away years ago.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Oh, right. We were merchants. But we took what we were owed! The crew hid Scurvyhook’s prized golden stash as payment for our suffering.
InProgressResponse: Yeah… There's more to life than mourning what was lost.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You look like you need a drink. Hoodwinked by Salazar, were you? You weren't the first, and won't be the last.

Title: Broken Communication
Description: Recover Myrtilus's Bow from the Angry Earth at Pisces.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Aside from one who is blind to the land talking with us? The seasons are amiss in Verdant Ascent.
InProgressResponse: Our bow was left where the fish swim across the sky.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Impressive! We did not expect much. All you did at first was stare.

Title: Spined Ammunition
Description: Recover Myrtilus's Quiver and Thornpoint Arrows from the Angry Earth at Fornax.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: If we returned, it would be like an early winter frost. There would be long discourses about the merits of staying secure at Eridanus.
InProgressResponse: The Thornpoint arrows were made specifically for use with this bow. Like a layer of strong bark, they protect against all sorts of dangers on the road.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Once again you do not disappoint. These arrows shall do nicely.

Title: Trail Rations
Description: Recover Nutrient Stalks from containers at Eridanus for Myrtilus.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: When times are good, a pleasant rain and warm sunlight is enough.
InProgressResponse: It is best to rely on sustenance untouched by foulness. Please bring us the nourishment we need to begin our journey.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: We can smell the freshness of the nutrient stalks from here. We relish the chance to have a taste while on the road.

Title: Unnatural Habitation
Description: Search Clawpoint Ruins for any clues as to why there are lynx in the area.
PlayerPrompt: "It's not like we can just leave."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: True. We're trapped on this island. Just like those poor lynx.
InProgressResponse: The clues are out there, I know it. I can feel the answer is at Clawpoint Ruins. Search the ruins and let me know what you discover.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Let me guess – you found cages, didn’t you?

Title: A Hair's Breadth from Danger
Description: Search the poacher's camp for any letters about their activities.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: When I visited the poachers camp, I was able to get answers to some of my questions, but it was clear there was more to their plans.
InProgressResponse: I need more information about what those poachers were doing. The lynx were just the smallest part of their plan.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Something has changed. Don’t tell me they've returned! Blast it, I should have burned that place to the ground when I had the chance!

Title: Rule of Tooth and Claw
Description: Right the wrongs done to the local wolf pack.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Our choices are limited. The damage has been done. And we don't have anything that can counter what they did.
InProgressResponse: You go on ahead, I'll be right behind you. The wolf cave isn't that far away, you can't miss it.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: So, you met the mad Caryn Berzs. She’s an odd one, I’ll give you that. She’s wanted for freeing the local dogs.

Title: Fisherman's Allure
Description: Search for treasure at Poseidon's Plunder for Wafa Keles.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: What do I have to offer? I’m good at spearfishing. And few can climb sea-slick rocks as well as I can.
InProgressResponse: I don't have much, but what I do have I'm willing to share with Xue Tian.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Is that what you found? Impressive! Xue will be thrilled to see this!

Title: Treasured Company
Description: Bring a letter from Wafa Keles to Xue Tien
PlayerPrompt: "You could ask him to appraise it."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Yes! I could say I found this goblet, and ask him to take a look. I like it! But I’m so nervous! Just the thought of talking to him makes me weak-kneed.
InProgressResponse: I know I’ll have to talk to Xue on my own someday… but could you ask him to stop by for me?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: A message from Wafa Keles asking me to appraise something called Poseidon’s Goblet? Sounds intriguing…

Title: Not Another Fish in the Sea
Description: Recover Xue's Sea Glass Charms from the Treetop pirates that stole them.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I needed some space. And had to get away from my overbearing family.
InProgressResponse: Those Treetop pirates stole my Sea Glass Charms. They would be a perfect gift for Wafa. Please get them back.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Those are perfect! Can you imagine them hanging from their hair, catching the sunlight as they dance through the waves?

Title: Meat For Nekumanesh (Expedition)
Description: Collect Hunks of Meat for Nekumanesh the alligator from Corrupted Leaders in The Depths Expedition.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: The alligator snaps at you, clearly offended by the insinuation that he isn't big enough.
InProgressResponse: Nekumanesh looks at you suspiciously. He had been expecting you to return with food.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: With a snap of his jaws, Nekumanesh hungrily devours the meat. As he looks up at you for more, you wonder: Did he just get a little bigger...?
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: Nekumanesh fidgets slightly, looking satisfied. He may be hungry for more later.

Title: Wispy Spritz Bombs
Description: The Bloom Herald offers to share the secret to true freedom if a rare blossom, the Wispy Bloom, can be safely collected.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: It can be yours. Let Hashiki Kimani, the chosen Bloom Herald, guide you.
InProgressResponse: Craft the Wispy Spritz bombs. Only with this item will you be able to collect the Wispyblooms and discover a secret world.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You’ve crafted the spritz, well done! Now you are ready to take the next step toward enlightenment.

Title: Springtide Bloom
Description: Armed with the Wispy Spritz bomb, the Bloom Herald has requested that the precious petals of the Wispyblooms be collected and brought to her in order to further the quest for harmony.
PlayerPrompt: “How exactly do I use the Spritz?”
ObjectiveProposalResponse: You must plant the traps on the ground then cleverly lure the wasp swarms to them before they explode.
InProgressResponse: Bring me the petals of the Wispybloom, Truth Seeker. I can help you achieve peace and harmony.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You bring me the keys to bliss! You are an exceptional Truth Seeker and worthy of being a Child of Bloom.
